events.what_it_is: A one-day NYFW café activation for NEST New York's Cardamom Latte Eau de Parfum, pairing fragrance discovery with complimentary Cardamom Lattes.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary Cardamom Lattes and fragrance sampling are advertised while supplies last.
events.caveats: Open to the public with no advance RSVP requirement published. Complimentary lattes and sampling are while supplies last. One roundup lists a 5 PM end time, but NYC for FREE, City Guide NY and WABC all publish 10 AM–9 PM; the 9 PM end is therefore used here.
events.practical_notes: Monday, September 14 from 10 AM–9 PM at Chelsea Triangle in the Meatpacking District. Arrive earlier if the complimentary latte is the priority because supplies can run out before closing.

events.address: Refinery Hotel, 63 W 38th St, New York, NY 10018
events.what_it_is: A limited-time Kemo Sabe pop-up inside Refinery Hotel's Hatbox with handcrafted hats, boots, leather goods, belts, accessories and the brand's custom hat-fitting experience.
events.what_is_free: Browsing and entry are free; merchandise and custom hat services are retail purchases.
events.caveats: Refinery Hotel's official page says the pop-up operates Tuesdays through Sundays from 11 AM–7 PM through September 27. Monday, September 14 is therefore not listed as an occurrence. No RSVP requirement is published.
events.practical_notes: Use the official hotel schedule rather than the broader date range alone: the pop-up is closed Mondays and open Tuesday–Sunday, 11 AM–7 PM.

events.event_name: Bobbi Brown The Prime Times Newsstand
events.address: Chelsea Triangle, 9th Ave between W 14th and W 15th St, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day Bobbi Brown newsstand activation for Vitamin Enriched Face Base+ with product discovery, refreshments, samples, giveaways and a mirrored photo moment.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary VEFB+ sample, refreshments and croissants, plus scratch-off giveaways while supplies last; the first 100 guests in line are advertised to receive a deluxe-size sample.
events.caveats: The organizer's live Eventbrite listing shows a $0 ticket for Thursday, September 17, 12–6 PM. Samples, refreshments and prizes are while supplies last. Photo/video capture is disclosed by the organizer.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, September 17 from 12–6 PM at Chelsea Triangle. Register through the organizer's Eventbrite page; arrive early if the deluxe sample is the priority because only the first 100 guests are advertised to receive it.

events.event_name: CookUnity The Most Legendary Lunch Break
events.address: Bari Bodega, 873 Broadway; Madison Square Deli & Convenience, 266 W 23rd St; New York Pizza and Cafe, 369 Madison Ave; Sam's Deli, 275 W 4th St; Slice N' Spice Deli & Grill, 451 3rd Ave, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: CookUnity's one-day takeover of five Manhattan bodegas and delis, with eight chefs serving complimentary chef-made meals and hot bites.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary chef-made meals and hot bites while supplies last; guests also receive bodega-style scratch-off tickets for prize opportunities.
events.caveats: Multiple current sources describe the event as open to the public with no RSVP requirement and complimentary food while supplies last. Inventory can run out before the published 2:30 PM end time.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, September 17 from 11:30 AM–2:30 PM at five Manhattan locations: Flatiron, Chelsea, Midtown, West Village and Murray Hill. Walk in; earlier arrival is advisable because meals are while supplies last.
